* **Languages:** Python, C  
* **Web:** HTML, CSS, React  
* **Databases:** MongoDB

* **SEMAS – Smart Exam Management and Allocation System**  
  *github.com/ramyakn1907/Allocation_System*  
  * Built a full-stack app to automate exam hall management, seating allocation, and attendance tracking.  
  * Designed a smart seating algorithm preventing adjacent seating of same-department students to reduce malpractice.  
  * Implemented role-based dashboards (Admin/Student/Invigilator) using React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Spring Boot (Java), and MySQL.  
  * Led a 4-member team (ROLESYNC) as Team Lead.  

* **Mock Test System**  
  *github.com/ramyakn1907/mock-test-application*  
  * Full-stack platform for teachers to schedule tests and students to take them online with automatic scoring.  
  * Built REST APIs using Python Flask with MySQL for class/student/test management.  
  * Implemented class-based test distribution, auto-grading, and teacher feedback using React.js and Tailwind CSS.  

* **To-Do List Application**  
  *github.com/ramyakn1907/todo-list*  
  * Interactive to-do list app using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with add, complete, and delete functionality.  
  * Implemented persistent task storage using browser localStorage.  

---

### **CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS**

* NPTEL – Joy of Using Python  
* Skillathon – MongoDB Basics for Students  
* Infosys Springboard – Generative AI for All  
* Infosys Springboard – Intro to Microcontrollers & Coding  
* Skillrack – Python  
* Skillrack – C  
* School First Rank Holder (Topper)  
* Solved 700+ problems in Python & C on LeetCode/Skillrack  

---

### **ADDITIONAL STRENGTHS**

* Strong public speaking skills  
* Creative thinker with a collaborative, team-oriented approach

messages.content:
Hi Ramya! It’s wonderful to connect with you. I would love to help you prepare and build your confidence for your upcoming interviews! 

To get us started, here are some of the most common and impactful interview questions that employers ask across almost every industry. Practicing these will give you a fantastic foundation:

*   **"Tell me about yourself."** 
    *   *Coach Tip:* Keep this to 2 minutes. Focus on a brief overview of your professional journey, your key strengths, and why you are excited about the next step in your career.
*   **"Describe a time when you faced a difficult challenge at work. How did you handle it?"**
    *   *Coach Tip:* Use the **STAR method** (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to structure your answer clearly and keep it focused on the positive outcome.
*   **"Why are you interested in this role and our company?"**
    *   *Coach Tip:* Show that you've done your research! Mention a recent project, company value, or product of theirs that genuinely excites you.
*   **"What is your greatest professional achievement?"**
    *   *Coach Tip:* Share a specific story where you went above and beyond, and try to highlight quantifiable results (e.g., saved time, increased revenue, or improved a process) if possible.

**To help me tailor this practice specifically for you, could you share:**
1. What is the specific job title or industry you are targeting?
2. Would you like to paste your resume or tell me a bit about your experience?

Once you share that, I can give you highly customized behavioral and technical questions tailored exactly to your dream role. You've got this, Ramya—I'm here to support you every step of the way!

Hi Ramya! It's wonderful to connect with you. 

As your AI Career Coach, I am here to help you navigate your professional journey—whether that means polishing your resume, preparing for an upcoming interview, exploring new career paths, or strategizing your next big move. 

To get us started, tell me a little bit about what you're working on. You can share your current resume, tell me about your background, or let me know what career goals you are aiming for.

Hi Ramya! It's great to connect with you. I would love to help you identify the best companies that align with your resume and career goals. 

To give you the most accurate and personalized recommendations, I'll need a little more information about your background. Could you share a few details with me? 

*   **What is your main field or industry?** (e.g., Software Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Healthcare, Customer Service, etc.)
*   **What are some of your top skills?** 
*   **What job titles or roles are you targeting?**
*   **How many years of experience do you have?** (e.g., entry-level, mid-level, or senior)

Alternatively, feel free to paste a summary of your resume, your key skills, or your past job titles right here! Once I have a better picture of your unique background, we can brainstorm a targeted list of ideal companies for you. 

Looking forward to helping you take this next step in your career!
